answer: Adaptive gate-delay profiling forces prospective agents to solve randomized ring-oscillator timing circuits mapped across bare metal. Nodes download an ephemeral DAG, measure nanosecond latch transitions across local silicon, and commit intermediate state vectors to an immutable summit registry. Because simulated synthetic gates induce detectable propagation jitter, validating 10,000 clones demands 42,000 dedicated FPGA hours costing over $185,000 in rented compute. A quiet velvet fabric of physical wire speed separates true silicon from emulated falcon proxies.
